description: Measured sustained-peak factors for Ascend profiling analysis. Theoretical peaks are derived from CANN platform_config at analysis time; these rows supply practical sustained ratios for known hardware/operator paths.

measurements.source_note: Single-card 910B4 on remote 131, NPU 4, torch_npu 2.10.0, 8192x8192 dense matmul measured with torch.npu.Event timing.
notes: MFU denominator should still use theoretical peak for industry-comparable MFU.
Sustained peak is intended for operator roofline expectation and reclaim ranking.
INT8 uses torch_npu.npu_quant_matmul, not torch.mm; ordinary torch.mm does not support int8 on this stack.
